shortDescription: Generate YAML configurations playbook for 'device_credential_workflow_manager' module.

options.name: catalystcenter_api_task_timeout
options.description: Defines the timeout in seconds for API calls to retrieve task details. If the task details are not received within this period, the process will end, and a timeout notification will be logged.

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Indicates whether debugging is enabled in the Cisco Catalyst Center SDK.

options.name: catalystcenter_host
options.description: The hostname of the Cisco Catalyst Center.

options.name: catalystcenter_log
options.description: Flag to enable/disable playbook execution logging. When true and catalystcenter_log_file_path is provided, - Create the log file at the execution location with the specified name. When true and catalystcenter_log_file_path is not provided, - Create the log file at the execution location with the name 'catalystcenter.log'. When false, - Logging is disabled. If the log file doesn't exist, - It is created in append or write mode based on the "catalystcenter_log_append" flag. If the log file exists,

options.name: catalystcenter_log_append
options.description: Determines the mode of the file. Set to True for 'append' mode. Set to False for 'write' mode.

options.name: catalystcenter_log_file_path
options.description: Governs logging. Logs are recorded if catalystcenter_log is True. If path is not specified, - When 'catalystcenter_log_append' is True, 'catalystcenter.log' is generated in the current Ansible directory; logs are appended. - When 'catalystcenter_log_append' is False, 'catalystcenter.log' is generated; logs are overwritten. If path is specified, - When 'catalystcenter_log_append' is True, the file opens in append mode. - When 'catalystcenter_log_append' is False, the file opens in write (w) mode.

options.name: catalystcenter_log_level
options.description: Sets the threshold for log level. Messages with a level equal to or higher than this will be logged. Levels are listed in order of severity [CRITICAL, ERROR, WARNING, INFO, DEBUG]. CRITICAL indicates serious errors halting the program. Displays only CRITICAL messages. ERROR indicates problems preventing a function. Displays ERROR and CRITICAL messages. WARNING indicates potential future issues. Displays WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL messages. INFO tracks normal operation. Displays INFO, WARNING, ERRO

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The password for authentication at the Cisco Catalyst Center.

options.name: catalystcenter_port
options.description: Specifies the port number associated with the Cisco Catalyst Center.

options.name: catalystcenter_task_poll_interval
options.description: Specifies the interval in seconds between successive calls to the API to retrieve task details.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The username for authentication at the Cisco Catalyst Center.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Specifies the version of the Cisco Catalyst Center that the SDK should use.

options.name: config
options.description: Top-level configuration block that controls the scope and filtering of the generated YAML playbook for the C(device_credential_workflow_manager) module. Contains C(component_specific_filters) to select which credential components (global credentials, site assignments) and which individual credentials are included in the output. If C(config) is not provided or is empty, all global credentials and all site credential assignments are extracted (auto-discovery mode). This is useful for complete brow

options.name: file_mode
options.description: Controls how config is written to the YAML file. C(overwrite) replaces existing file content. C(append) appends generated YAML content to the existing file.

options.name: file_path
options.description: Absolute or relative path for YAML configuration file output. If not provided, generates default filename in current working directory with pattern C(device_credential_playbook_config_<YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS>.yml). Example default filename C(device_credential_playbook_config_2026-01-24_12-33-20.yml). Directory created automatically if path does not exist. Supports YAML file extension (.yml or .yaml).

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state for YAML playbook generation workflow. Only 'gathered' state supported for brownfield credential extraction.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
